regions.text: Approved by AlCTE & Govt.of Maharashtra |Affiliated to University of Mumbai
Sub:SIH 2026-Guidance Session on Effective PPT Preparation for SIH 2026
As part of the preparation for Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026, an orientation session has
been organised to guide students on effective PPT preparation,presentation skills, and
confident interaction with judges. The session will focus on:
PPT Structure & Content-Clear problem statement proposed solution, innovation
Design & Presentation-Professional visuals, clarity, confidence, and effective time
Interaction with Judges -Handling questions confidently, clearly, and precisely.
Final Submission-Ensuring all required deliverables are complete and submitted on time.
All concerned faculty members are requested to encourage the participating students to attend
the session and benefit from the guidance provided
